stories.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Builder and Recruiting Filter Enforcement
stories.description: Implement query construction logic to ClinicalTrials.gov API ensuring recruiting status filter is always applied and condition/location parameters are correctly encoded.

stories.title: Trial Location Extraction and Normalization
stories.description: Extract trial site locations from API response and normalize into structured location objects suitable for distance calculation and frontend display.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Duration Calculation via Google Routes
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration between user location and each trial site with graceful fallback for missing or invalid locations.

stories.title: External API Error Handling and Rate Limit Resilience
stories.description: Implement robust error handling, retry logic, and timeout management for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes API calls to ensure system stability under failures and rate limits.
stories.evidence: GAP: Retry/backoff and resilience patterns not explicitly defined in current clinical_trials_service; must be implemented
